$doc: Prospect maturation lifecycle config — entry/exit criteria, qualification gates, and operator guidance. Maps to PROSPECT_CANONICAL_STAGES in lib/cmp/_lib/prospect-operations-view-model.js. No schema changes. No external send.

new.label: New
new.description: Prospect has submitted an intake form but has not yet been reviewed by an operator.
exit_criteria: Operator has reviewed and assigned an owner
Initial qualification started (move to qualifying)

qualifying.label: Qualifying
qualifying.description: Operator is actively assessing fit: business size, urgency, budget signals, decision-making authority.
entry_criteria: Acknowledgement sent (draft prepared and reviewed by operator)
exit_criteria: Qualification criteria met (see qualification_gates below)
Discovery/demo booked (move to discovery_booked)
Insufficient fit identified (move to not_fit or lost)

discovery_booked.label: Discovery Booked
discovery_booked.description: Discovery call or demo is scheduled. Operator preparing discovery assets.
exit_criteria: Discovery call completed
Proposal ready to assemble (move to proposal_ready)
Not a fit confirmed (move to not_fit or lost)

proposal_ready.label: Proposal Ready
proposal_ready.description: Operator has assembled the proposal internally. Pending commercial review before sending.
exit_criteria: Proposal reviewed and approved for send
Proposal sent to prospect (move to proposal_sent)

proposal_sent.label: Proposal Sent
proposal_sent.description: Proposal has been sent to prospect. Awaiting response.
entry_criteria: Proposal draft reviewed by operator (not auto-sent)
exit_criteria: Prospect accepts — awaiting payment (move to awaiting_payment)
Prospect declines — lost (move to lost)
No response after follow-up cadence — stalled (move to stalled)

awaiting_payment.label: Awaiting Payment
awaiting_payment.description: Prospect has verbally or formally accepted. Payment link sent or invoice issued.
entry_criteria: Verbal or written acceptance from prospect
exit_criteria: Payment confirmed by operator (protected action — not auto-marked)
Move to won

won.label: Won
won.description: Payment received and confirmed. Onboarding initiated.
exit_criteria: Onboarding complete — move to delivery

delivery.label: In Delivery
delivery.description: Active client in the delivery/pilot phase.
exit_criteria: Delivery complete — close in CMP
Stalled during delivery — move to stalled

stalled.label: Stalled
stalled.description: Progress has stopped. Operator must log reason and set a reactivation target.
entry_criteria: No meaningful activity for stale_days_threshold days
Explicitly moved by operator with a reason
exit_criteria: Reactivation confirmed — move back to appropriate active stage
No reactivation possible — move to lost or not_fit

lost.label: Lost
lost.description: Prospect declined or is unresponsive after full follow-up cadence.
entry_criteria: Follow-up cadence exhausted with no response
exit_criteria: Reactivation signal received (move to new or qualifying)

not_fit.label: Not a Fit
not_fit.description: Prospect does not meet qualification criteria and will not be pursued.
exit_criteria: Re-qualification if business circumstances change (move to new or qualifying)

ai_lead_rescue.label: AI Lead Rescue — Qualification Gate
ai_lead_rescue.description: Minimum criteria to advance from qualifying to discovery_booked for AI Lead Rescue.

required.label: Business name confirmed
required.rationale: Cannot build a personalised lead rescue system without knowing the business

required.label: Contact email verified
required.rationale: Required for proposal delivery and onboarding

required.label: Region or lead source context provided
required.rationale: Needed to assess rescue feasibility and scope

required.label: Urgency or timeline signal present
required.rationale: Affects discovery call prioritisation and proposal timing

disqualifiers: No identifiable business (individual only, no commercial operation)
Explicitly no budget or unwilling to discuss commercial terms
Already engaged with a conflicting full-service provider in the same scope

website_rescue.label: Website Rescue — Qualification Gate
website_rescue.description: Minimum criteria to advance from qualifying to discovery_booked for Website Rescue / Rapid Delivery.

required.label: Business name confirmed
required.rationale: Required to scope the rescue work

required.label: Current website URL or description provided
required.rationale: Cannot assess rescue scope without seeing current state

required.label: Service path / offer slug confirmed
required.rationale: Determines which rescue package applies and MUR pricing

disqualifiers: No website and no intent to create one
Scope exceeds rapid delivery (multi-site, complex integrations) — escalate to full project
Competitor research or free advice only
